name: hemant-plugins
description: Plugins for ponytail, graphify and OmniRoute. Each plugin points to its upstream project.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode: the simplest solution that works. Pulled from upstream DietrichGebert/ponytail.

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Turn code, docs, PDFs and images into a queryable knowledge graph with /graphify (Graphify-Labs/graphify).

plugins.name: omniroute
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to the OmniRoute AI gateway over MCP, with a setup skill (cheaper-inference/OmniRoute).
